items.text: Zhangjiagang is an industrial city that uses advanced technology to treat household waste. Instead of putting waste in landfills, the city uses incineration , a process where waste is burned in a smart and fully enclosed facility. This process creates electricity and heat that is reused in nearby factories. Thanks to this method, the city has entered a zero landfill era, where no household waste is buried in the ground. The waste treatment center is very modern and clean. There is no bad smell or visible garbage. Everything is monitored and controlled through a central system. Even kitchen waste is burned together with regular waste to produce more energy. The plant produces enough electricity each year for around 60,000 households. After incineration, the remaining residue is not thrown away. Companies turn it into construction materials, and the steam produced during the process is piped to small businesses for daily use. Hazardous waste is also handled safely. Through technology and teamwork between companies, Zhangjiagang has created a full recycling system that protects the environment. Difficult words: incineration (burning waste), residue (what is left after something is burned or removed), hazardous (dangerous or harmful). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Zhangjiagang is a city in China that has a new and smart way of treating household waste . It doesn’t use landfills anymore. Now, a computer system controls burning the waste in a special, closed building. This makes electricity and heat for homes and factories. The place is very clean, and there is no smell or trash on the ground. Kitchen waste and household waste are burned together, which gives more power. The city makes enough electricity for 60,000 homes every year. After burning, the rest of the waste goes to companies that make building materials. The heat from burning helps small businesses nearby. Workers handle dangerous waste safely. The system uses waste to help people and protect the environment. Difficult words: smart (clever), waste (things and materials which people throw away), landfill (a place where people put waste in the ground). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Zhangjiagang is a city in China. It has a new way to take care of waste . People do not put trash in the ground now. The city burns trash in a special place. This makes power and heat. The place is clean. It has no smell. A computer helps control the work. Food waste and home waste go in together. The power helps people in their homes. It is enough for 60,000 homes. After burning, some waste is used to make things for building. The hot air goes to small shops. Dangerous waste also goes to a safe place. This new way helps people and keeps the city clean. Difficult words: waste (things which people throw away), power (energy which helps machines and lights work), dangerous (not safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Scientists and communities are making great progress in nature conservation . In the Democratic Republic of Congo, people create a large area for animals to travel safely between parks. This project also helps local groups own their land again after many years. At the same time, experts discover thousands of new species every year, which shows that our planet still has many secrets to share. New technology is also protecting ocean life from danger. Companies now use special cameras and computer programs to find whales near large ships. This system sends an alert to the crew to prevent accidents. Furthermore, researchers use drones to put cameras on blue whales. This method doesn’t cause stress to the animals and helps us understand how climate change affects their behavior in the wild. In the energy sector, battery storage is now much cheaper and more efficient . This change allows businesses to use solar power even during the night. Also, the European Union introduces new rules for the clothing industry to reduce waste. These laws force companies to pay for the environmental damage they cause. This move helps fight the problem of low-quality clothes that people throw away quickly. Difficult words: conservation (the protection of natural things), species (a group of animals or plants that are the same), efficient (working well without wasting anything). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Many good things happened in the world in February. In Africa, people built a large path for animals to move safely. This helps nature and gives land back to local communities. Also, scientists find more than 16,000 new plants and animals every year. We learn more about our world every day. New technology helps save whales in the ocean. A new computer system finds whales near ships and tells the captain to move the ship or slow down. This way, the ship doesn’t hit the animal. Other experts use drones to watch blue whales. They want to see how these big animals live and find food. Clean energy is now cheaper for everyone. Batteries for solar power cost much less than before. Now, we can use the sun to get light at night too. In Europe, new rules stop fashion companies from making too much waste . These companies must pay more money if they hurt the planet. Difficult words: path (a track for walking), captain (the person who is the leader of a ship or a plane), waste (things which you throw away). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a lot of good news today. In Africa, people help wild animals. They make a safe path for them to live and travel. Scientists also find many new animals and plants every year. The world is a beautiful place with many secrets . Ships use a new computer system. This system tells the ship if there is a whale. The ship can stop or move away. Other experts use drones to watch whales. Green energy is very cheap now. We have good batteries for solar power . We can use the sun at night too. In Europe, there are new rules for clothes. Companies must not make too much trash. They must help the planet. Difficult words: wild (an animal which lives free), secret (something what people do not know), solar power (energy from the sun). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new report reveals that nearly all glaciers in Austria are shrinking due to climate change. According to the Austrian Alpine Club, 94 of the country’s 96 glaciers retreated during the last two years. Some glaciers lost more than 100 metres in length, while the average retreat was over 20 metres. One of the most affected is the Pasterze Glacier, where the glacier tongue is breaking apart. Scientists say higher temperatures and low snowfall are the main reasons for the loss of ice. For example, June last year was almost 5°C warmer than usual. Similar changes are happening in nearby Switzerland, where glaciers have already lost about a quarter of their size since 2015. Experts warn that melting glaciers could affect drinking water, energy production, farming, tourism, and the Alpine landscape. They say these changes should be a wake-up call for governments and the public to take climate change more seriously. Difficult words: retreat (to move back or become smaller), average (the usual or typical amount when you combine numbers and divide them), wake-up call (an event that warns people that a serious problem needs attention). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Most glaciers in Austria are becoming smaller. A report from the Austrian Alpine Club says 94 of the country’s 96 glaciers moved back in the last two years. Some glaciers became more than 100 metres shorter. The Pasterze Glacier is breaking apart . Scientists say warm temperatures and low snowfall are causing this change. Last year, June was about 5°C hotter than normal. Similar glacier loss is happening in Switzerland and other places in the world. Experts say melting glaciers could affect water, energy, farming, and tourism in the mountains. They believe these changes show that climate change is becoming a serious problem. Difficult words: glacier (a very large, slow-moving mass of ice in mountains), break apart (to split into smaller pieces), melt (to change into water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Most glaciers in Austria are getting smaller. A report says that 94 of 96 glaciers move back in the last two years. The Pasterze Glacier is also breaking apart . Scientists say that this happens because of warmer weather and less snow. Last year, June is much hotter than usual. Similar changes are happening in Switzerland and other countries. Experts say that melting glaciers can bring problems for water, energy, and tourism in the mountains. It is time to think about how to stop climate change. Difficult words: glacier (a river of ice which moves down a mountain), break apart (to break into smaller pieces), melt (to change into water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new political party in Nepal has won a large victory in the country’s general election. The three-year-old party gained 182 of the 275 seats in parliament, the biggest majority in more than 60 years. Its leader, Balendra Shah, a former rapper and mayor of Kathmandu, is now expected to become the next prime minister. His music often criticized corruption and powerful politicians, which made him popular with young voters. The election happened after major protests led by Gen Z last September. The protests started partly because the government tried to ban social media and because many young people were angry about corruption and the lack of jobs. During the protests, 77 people died, and the government collapsed. Young voters supported Shah because they wanted new leaders instead of older politicians who had ruled the country for many years. His party promises to investigate corruption, create jobs, and grow the economy. However, critics say these goals may be difficult to achieve. Difficult words: corruption (dishonest use of power), Gen Z (people born roughly between the late 1990s and early 2010s; today they are mostly teenagers or young adults). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A new party, which is only three years old, won the national election in Nepal. Its leader, Balendra Shah, used to be a rapper and the mayor of Kathmandu. He is now likely to become the next prime minister. The election happened after large protests by young people last year. Many people were angry about corruption , job problems, and a plan to ban social media. The protests became very serious, and 77 people died. The government then fell, and a new election was called. Many young voters supported the new party because they wanted change and new leaders. The party promises to fight corruption and create more jobs, but some critics say these plans may be hard to complete. Difficult words: mayor (the elected leader of a city or town), likely (something that will probably happen), corruption (when people in power use their position to get money or benefits). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new political party wins the election in Nepal. The party is only three years old. Its leader is Balendra Shah. He is a rapper and the mayor of Kathmandu in the past. He may become the next prime minister. The election happens after big protests by young people. Many people are angry about corruption and problems with jobs. 77 people die during the protests. The government falls. Many young people want change. They like the new party. The party says that it will fight corruption and help create jobs in the country. But many people believe that it will be very hard. Difficult words: election (when people vote for leaders), mayor (the leader of a city or town), corruption (when people in power use their position in a bad way, usually to get money or benefits). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new global survey has started a strong debate online. The study asked more than 23,000 adults in 29 countries about gender roles and equality . It shows that almost one-third of Gen Z men believe a wife should obey her husband. This share is much higher than among older men. Many people reacted with anger on social media. The results show a clear divide between young men and young women. Many young women support equal roles in work and family life. However, many young men say they prefer more traditional roles, where the man has more control in the home. The survey also found that some young men believe men are now asked to do too much to support equality. Experts say social media influencers and political messages may support these views. Some young women say these attitudes make them feel worried about their future. Researchers say progress will require men and women to work together to build a fair society. Difficult words: equality (when people have the same rights and opportunities), obey (to do what someone tells you to do), equal (the same in rights, value, or importance). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A new survey about gender roles caused debate online. Researchers asked more than 23,000 adults in 29 countries about equality between men and women. It shows that almost one-third of Gen Z men think a wife should obey her husband. This number is much higher than for older men. Many people shared angry comments on social media after the results came out. The results show a big difference between young men and young women. Many young women want equality in family and work. Many young men say they prefer more traditional roles. Experts say social media influencers and political messages may influence these ideas. They say men and women need to work together to create a fair society. Difficult words: survey (a study), equality (when people have the same rights and opportunities), obey (to do what someone tells you to do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A new study asks people about men and women. The study asks more than 23,000 people in many countries. It finds that many young men think that a wife should listen to her husband. This idea is more usual in young men than in older men. Many people online were angry about this result. It shows a big difference between young men and young women. Many young women want equality at home and at work. Experts say that social media and influencers affect how young men think. They say that men and women need to work together to build a fair world for everyone. Difficult words: difference (the way things are not the same), equality (when people can do the same things), affect (to change or have an impact on something or someone). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lego is preparing for higher costs because energy and basic materials are becoming more expensive due to the conflict in the Middle East. The company uses oil-based plastic to make its toys, so higher oil prices may slowly increase the cost of production. The price of crude oil has already risen by about 65% since the US and Israel bombed Iran on February 28. However, Lego says the effect may be slow because it already has supply agreements that help control prices for some time. The company is also dealing with changes in US import taxes. After the Supreme Court removed some earlier tariffs introduced by President Donald Trump, a new general tariff of 10% was announced, and it could rise to 15%. Lego says its strategy of building factories close to important markets helps reduce risk and keep costs under control. For example, Lego plans to open its first manufacturing plant in the United States, in Virginia, in 2027. Despite these pressures, the family-owned company reported growth in all regions and product groups last year and expects sales to keep growing this year. Difficult words: crude oil (oil in its natural form before it is cleaned or processed), supply (the amount of something available to use or sell), general (affecting many things or most people, not specific). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Lego may face higher costs because energy and materials are getting more expensive during the conflict in the Middle East. Oil prices increased by about 65% since the US and Israel bombed Iran. Lego uses plastic made from oil, so making toys could slowly become more expensive. However, the company says current supply deals may slow down the effect. Lego is also dealing with new import taxes in the United States. A tax of 10% could increase to 15%, which would make the products more expensive. To reduce costs, Lego builds factories close to its main markets. The company plans to open its first factory in the United States, in Virginia, in 2027. Even with these problems, Lego reported growth last year and expects to continue growing this year. Difficult words: costs (the money you need to make, buy, or do something), supply (the amount of something available to use or sell), growth (when something becomes bigger or more successful). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lego may cost more because energy and materials are becoming more expensive . The reason is the conflict in the Middle East. Oil prices are going up a lot. Lego uses oil to make plastic bricks . Toys may cost more to make. The company must also pay new taxes on products in the United States. To stop this, Lego builds factories close to where people buy its toys. It plans to open its first factory in the United States in Virginia in 2027. Even with these problems, Lego is still growing. The company has good sales last year. It seems that this year will be good, too. Difficult words: expensive (when something costs a lot of money), brick (a small block for building things), tax (money we pay to the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Forever chemicals, also called PFAS, are man-made substances used in many everyday items because they resist water, heat, and grease. You can find them in non-stick pans, raincoats, fast-food wrappers, cosmetics, coffee cups, and even in food and water. They are called forever chemicals because they don’t break down easily and stay in the environment for a very long time. Some studies suggest that PFAS may harm human health, affect fertility , and increase the risk of cancer. Regulators say most PFAS are safe at low levels, but the long-term effects of multiple chemicals in the body are not fully known. Courts in some countries, like Sweden, recognize high PFAS levels in the blood as a personal injury. People can reduce exposure by checking product labels and avoiding items with these chemicals, like waterproof furniture, stain-resistant fabrics, or certain cosmetics. Understanding PFAS helps us weigh the risks and benefits of everyday products and control our chemical footprint. Difficult words: resist (to not be affected by something), fertility (the ability to have babies), multiple (more than one), exposure (being in contact with something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Forever chemicals, called PFAS, are man-made substances which you can find in many things you use every day. They are in non-stick pans, waterproof clothes, fast-food wrappers, cosmetics, and even food and water. These chemicals don’t break down in nature, so they stay there for a long time. Some studies say PFAS may cause health problems, like lower fertility or some cancers. Rules say small amounts are safe, but scientists are still studying long-term effects on people and nature. You can lower your contact with PFAS by reading labels and carefully choosing what you buy and eat. Learning about these chemicals helps people be safe and healthy. Difficult words: non-stick (a thing or material that does not let food stick to it), waterproof (material that doesn’t let water go through), fertility (the ability to have babies). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Forever chemicals, called PFAS, are in many things that we use every day. They are in non-stick pans, raincoats, food wrappers, makeup, and water. They stay in water and soil for a very long time. Some research says that PFAS can make people sick, for example, make it harder to have babies or cause some types of cancer . Rules say that small amounts are safe. But we do not know all the dangers. You can stay away from PFAS. Read labels and do not use some products like long-lasting makeup, stain-proof chairs, or waterproof straws. If people know about PFAS, they can stay safe and healthy. Difficult words: non-stick (a thing or material that does not let food stick to it), cancer (a serious illness where cells grow out of control), amount (how much of something there is), stain-proof (when something does not get dirty or show marks easily). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Andrea Rost is a famous Hungarian soprano who has performed on the world’s greatest opera stages. She has also tried other creative work, like jazz, audiobooks, jewelry design, and founding an opera academy. Recently, she changed her focus to politics to campaign for change and support young talent. Her first major political action was performing at a demonstration in April 2024, which led to consequences in her music career, but she continued to participate in opposition events. Now a vice president of the TISZA Party’s and a candidate for office, Rost motivates people through music and public engagement. She believes in fighting oppression and wants her country to reach its potential. Rost trained formally at the Academy of Music and rose to international fame. She performed at Vienna, La Scala, Salzburg, Paris, London, and New York. She draws inspiration from nature and introspection , and she has led crowds singing freedom songs at political events. Difficult words: campaign (to work for something, like an idea or election, and try to get support), consequence (something that happens because of an action, result), oppression (unfair treatment or control over people), introspection (thinking deeply about yourself and your feelings). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Andrea Rost is a famous Hungarian opera singer who performed around the world. She also worked with jazz, audiobooks, jewelry, and founded an opera academy. Recently, she started focusing on politics. She is helping young people and campaigning for change. She first acted politically in April 2024 at a demonstration, and though it had an impact on her music, she still took part in opposition events. She is now a vice president of the TISZA Party group and a candidate for office. She is using music to bring people together. Rost grew up in Szolnok, where she first learned classical music from a TV program by Leonard Bernstein. She studied music formally, became famous all over the world, and performed in many big opera houses. She led large crowds singing songs at political events. Difficult words: campaign (to work for something, like an idea or election, and try to get support), opposition (a group or people who disagree with or fight against another group), candidate (a person who is trying to get a job, position, or elected office). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Andrea Rost is a famous singer from Hungary. She sings opera. She performs in many countries. She also works with jazz, books, and jewelry , and she is starting her own music school. Now she works in politics and helps young people. She first is at a protest in 2024. It has a big impact on her singing. But she continues to go to political events. Rost is a leader in the TISZA Party. She wants to make changes in her country. She grows up in Szolnok. She watches music on TV when is a child. Rost studies music, becomes very famous, and sings in many famous opera houses . She likes nature and sings songs with people at political events. Difficult words: jewelry (rings, necklaces, bracelets, and other decorative things which people wear), continue (to keep doing something), opera house (a building where people perform opera). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

An undercover BBC investigation revealed that many businesses in England and Wales have displayed inaccurate food hygiene ratings. These ratings, provided by the Food Standards Agency (FSA), are meant to ensure customers that food safety standards are met. However, secret filming revealed that, from small local restaurants to a supermarket chain, some businesses were lying about their ratings. This could be considered fraud because places were intentionally leaving incorrect ratings visible. Businesses that were confronted reacted differently. Some denied any deliberate deception , while others remained silent. A Sainsbury’s supermarket had shown a high hygiene rating of five, but in reality, it had a score of zero due to serious hygiene issues. Food safety experts believe this is a widespread problem across the UK, with multiple places misleading the public about their hygiene standards. Difficult words: food hygiene (guidelines used to describe handling, preparation, and storage of food), confront (to challenge someone directly), deception (hiding the truth). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An undercover BBC investigation showed that some food businesses in England and Wales are not telling the truth about their hygiene ratings . The Food Standards Agency (FSA) gives these ratings to show how clean and safe a place is and how it handles food. But some places were lying. They were showing better ratings than they had. For example, a Sainsbury’s supermarket said it had a score of five, but the truth was that it had a zero because of serious problems. Experts said this is happening in many other places, too. When journalists asked about it, some businesses denied it, and others didn’t say anything at all. Food experts say this problem is usual across the UK. Difficult words: undercover (secret), rating (grade), deny (to say that something is false). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The BBC finds out that some food places, like small restaurants and supermarkets, in England and Wales are not honest. They lie about their food hygiene. Food hygiene are rules on how to keep and prepare food. The Food Standards Agency gives a score from zero to five to show if a place is clean and safe. But some places put better scores than they really have. For example, a Sainsbury’s store says it has a score of five. But it is a zero. BBC reporters ask some places about it. They say that they do not lie. Others do not say anything at all. Experts say that this problem is happening in many places in the UK. Difficult words: lie (to not tell the truth), rule (a statement which says what you can or cannot do), score (a number which shows how good something is). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran has also affected the United Arab Emirates. Some Iranian missiles targeted parts of the country, including an area near Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, although defense systems stopped most of them. During the first days of the conflict, many influencers based in Dubai posted messages about safety and trust in the country’s leadership. Journalists analyzed more than one hundred social media posts from influencers and noticed unusual patterns . Many posts used almost identical wording and repeated phrases about strong air defense, safety, and national stability. In several cases, influencers posted very similar messages within seconds or minutes of each other. The posts also received unusually high engagement , such as views, likes, and shares. Experts say this can happen naturally during major events, but it may also result from coordinated promotion or automated accounts. Influencers play an important role in the UAE economy, but strict laws control online content and punish posts that spread information authorities consider false. Difficult words: pattern (something that repeats in the same way), engagement (interaction such as likes or shares online), coordinated (organized so people act together in a planned way). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran also reaches the United Arab Emirates. Some Iranian rockets targeted parts of the country, but defense systems stopped most of them. During this time, many influencers in Dubai posted messages about safety and strong leaders. Journalists studied 129 social media posts from influencers. They found that many messages used very similar words and phrases. Some influencers even posted almost at the same time. The posts talked about safety, strong defense systems, and trust in the country’s leaders. These posts also received many likes and shares. This may happen during big news events, but sometimes groups coordinate posts to spread a message. The UAE also has strict rules about what people can post online. Difficult words: target (To hit or affect a person, place, or thing), defense system (equipment and technology which protects a country from attacks), coordinate (to organize people or actions so they work together). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. Some Iranian rockets fly toward the United Arab Emirates. But the country stops most of them. During this time, many influencers in Dubai post messages online. Many of the posts use the same words. They are about safety and strong leaders. Some influencers post almost at the same time. Journalists study more than one hundred posts and see similar things. The posts also get many likes and shares. Some people think that somebody controls these posts. The UAE also has strict rules about what people can say online. Difficult words: influencer (a person on social media who can affect what other people think or buy), safety (when you are safe), similar (almost the same). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the Casbah of Algiers, traditional arts and crafts, such as leatherworking, have been passed down for generations. However, craftsmen like Boulachab Nasser fear this heritage might disappear due to a lack of interest and support. Nasser is a fourth-generation leatherworker, having learned the craft from his ancestors . Over time, his family gained experience, passing down valuable techniques and knowledge. Despite their efforts, Nasser sees fewer young people willing to learn these trades, especially males in his family. He continues his work out of love, but he admits it is difficult to make a living from it. The Casbah itself, rich in history and culture, represents the spirit of Algiers, and the products made by craftsmen like Nasser reflect this identity. The concern is that with fewer people learning these skills, traditional crafts will vanish . Difficult words: heritage (traditions or knowledge passed from earlier generations), ancestor (a person related to you who lived a long time ago), vanish (to disappear). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In the Casbah of Algiers, people like Boulachab Nasser make traditional crafts . Nasser is a leatherworker, and he learned his job from his family. Four generations passed down their skills from father to son. They learned new techniques over the years, but now Nasser worries that these crafts are slowly disappearing because people are no longer interested. He still loves what he does, but he says it is hard to make a living from it. Young people, especially the men in his family, are not learning these traditional crafts anymore. The Casbah itself is a very important and historic part of Algiers. The products Nasser makes show the culture and history of his city, but he fears that these traditions could disappear if younger generations don’t continue them. Difficult words: craft (an activity which involves making things by hand), skill (the ability to do something well), technique (a special method of doing something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Boulachab Nasser lives in the Casbah of Algiers. He makes things by hand for many years. Nasser is a leatherworker . He learns this job from his family. Four generations of men pass the skills from one to the next. But now, Nasser is worried that not many people are interested in this work anymore. He loves his job very much. It is getting hard to make money from it. He is sad because young people, especially the men in his family, do not want to learn how to do this. The Casbah is a very old and important place in Algiers. The work Nasser does shows the culture and history of his city. However, he is afraid that if young people do not learn these crafts , they will not exist anymore. Difficult words: leatherworker (a person who works with leather, an animal skin), generation (people in a family born at the same time), craft (making things by hand). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

AI now plays an important role in modern conflict and surveillance . Recent US military actions in Iran and Venezuela reportedly used AI to support planning and decision-making. AI can analyze satellite images, identify possible targets, and simulate many scenarios to predict how an enemy might respond. This technology helps military leaders make faster decisions than in the past. AI is also used outside the battlefield. Some government agencies use similar technology to track people, including immigrants. This has caused strong criticism and started a debate about privacy and control. Disagreements have also appeared between the US government and AI companies about how their systems should be used in military operations. Experts warn about serious risks. A recent study showed that many leading AI models suggested nuclear threats in about 95 percent of simulated crises. Some companies try to limit dangerous uses, but others sign military deals. Specialists say the world needs clear global regulation before AI becomes more powerful in war. Difficult words: surveillance (careful watching of people or places), simulate (to create a situation that is similar to a real one to study what may happen), scenario (a possible situation that could happen), regulation (an official rule to control something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

AI is becoming important in modern war. The US military uses AI to study images, find targets , and test different war situations. This helps leaders decide faster. Governments also use AI to track people, and many people criticize this because they worry about privacy . There are also disagreements between the US government and technology companies about how to use AI in war. Experts warn that AI may create new dangers. In one study, many AI models suggested nuclear conflicts in most of the dangerous situations. Because of these risks, some companies have more rules for their technology. Experts say the world needs clear rules for AI in war. Difficult words: target (a person or place chosen for attack), track (to follow where someone or something goes), privacy (the right to keep your personal life and information secret). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Countries use AI in modern war. The US military uses AI to study images and choose people and buildings to attack. AI also helps leaders think about battle situations. Some government groups also use AI to watch and track people. Many people worry about this because of privacy . Companies and leaders are talking about using AI safely. Experts also see a big problem. In tests, many AI systems speak about nuclear bombs in new wars. Some companies have more rules about their AI. Experts say that countries need clear rules for AI in war. Difficult words: battle (a fight in a war), track (to follow where someone or something goes), privacy (keeping your personal life and information to yourself). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US government recently had a dispute with the AI company Anthropic about how the military could use its technology. Anthropic didn’t want to give the Pentagon full access to its AI system. Because of this disagreement , the Trump administration ended its cooperation with the company. Soon after this decision, OpenAI made its own agreement with the Pentagon. However, the deal quickly received criticism from both inside and outside the company. Some people believed OpenAI acted too quickly and tried to take advantage of the situation. In response, CEO Sam Altman said the company would make changes and add more safety measures . The discussion shows growing use of AI in war. Several technology companies compete to work with the US military on new tools such as autonomous drones. Experts say AI may become an important part of future wars, but many people worry about risks and the possible misuse of powerful technology. Difficult words: dispute (a serious argument or conflict between people or groups), disagreement (when people have different opinions and do not agree), measures (action taken to deal with a problem). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US government had a problem with the AI company Anthropic because it didn’t want the military to have full access to its AI technology. Because of this problem, the government stopped working with Anthropic. Soon after, another company, OpenAI, made a deal with the Pentagon. Many people criticized this deal and said the company acted too quickly. OpenAI’s leader, Sam Altman, later said the company would change parts of the deal and add more safety rules. Many technology companies now compete to work with the US military. They develop new tools such as smart drones. Some experts say AI will play a big role in future wars, but other people worry about risks. Difficult words: access (the right to use or enter something), criticize (to say that something is wrong or not good), safety (being safe from danger or harm). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US government works with technology companies which make AI. One company, Anthropic, has a problem with the military . The company does not want the military to use its AI without rules. So the government stops working with it. Another company, OpenAI, makes a deal with the Pentagon. But many people say that the company makes the deal too quickly. The leader of OpenAI says that the company will change the deal. It will have more safety rules . Many companies now want to work with the military on AI technology. Some people think that AI will be important in new wars. Many people worry about new risks. Difficult words: government (the group of people who run and manage a country), military (the people, ships, and planes which keep a country safe), safety rules (what you must and must not do to keep things or people safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

President Donald Trump welcomed the soccer team Inter Miami to the White House after the team won the 2025 MLS Cup. The team won the final game 3–1 against Vancouver in December. The visit was special because Lionel Messi, one of the most famous soccer players in the world, also came to the White House. During the event, the president praised the team and their success. He said it was a special moment and his privilege because no American president had welcomed Messi to the White House before. Trump also said his son Barron is a big fan of Messi and of another famous player, Cristiano Ronaldo. Messi and Jorge Mas, one of theclub owners, gave the president several gifts. They presented him with a team jersey with the number 47 and a special soccer ball. The team also invited the president to celebrate their championship victory together. Difficult words: privilege (a special honor or opportunity that not everyone has), praise (to say good things about someone), jersey (a shirt that players wear in sport). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

President Donald Trump welcomed the soccer team Inter Miami to the White House. The team won the 2025 MLS Cup after a 3–1 win over Vancouver. Famous player Lionel Messi came with the team. You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Disney plans to launch its biggest cruise ship, Disney Adventure. The ship can carry 6,700 passengers and will start short trips from Singapore. Each trip will last three or four nights. This is the first time Disney will send a cruise ship to this part of Asia. The company wants to expand outside the United States. Fewer international tourists now choose the United States for travel. Because of this change, Disney looks for new chances in Asia. The company already has theme parks in several Asian cities, but it doesn’t have a cruise ship in Southeast Asia. Leaders see this region as an important market with strong future growth. The ship offers many attractions based on famous Disney stories, such as Marvel and Frozen. Families of different ages can travel together and enjoy the activities. Disney also plans further expansion and wants to add five more ships between 2027 and 2031. Difficult words: expand (to grow or become bigger), expansion (growth of a business), add (to put something new in). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Disney will start a new and very big cruise ship called Disney Adventure. The ship will carry 6,700 passengers and will leave from Singapore. People can take short trips for three or four nights. Disney wants to grow its cruise business in Asia because fewer tourists now travel to the United States. Because of this, Disney looks for a new market in Asia. The company already has theme parks there, but it doesn’t have a cruise ship in this part of the world. Leaders think many families there want this kind of holiday. The ship has fun areas from popular Disney stories like Marvel and Frozen. Families can spend time together on the ship. Disney also plans to build five more ships in the future. Difficult words: cruise ship (a large ship where people travel for fun and sleep on the ship), passenger (a person who travels on a ship or plane), market (a group of people who want to buy something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Disney has a new big ship. Its name is Disney Adventure. The ship can carry 6,700 people. It starts in Singapore. People go on short trips for three or four nights. Disney wants more people to travel in Asia. Fewer people go to the United States for holidays. So Disney looks for a new place for its cruise business. The company has theme parks in Asia. Now it has a cruise ship there too. The ship has fun places from Disney stories like Frozen and Marvel. Families travel together on the ship. Disney plans more ships in the future. Difficult words: carry (to take people or things from one place to another), cruise (a trip on a ship), theme park (a large park with rides and attractions based on stories or ideas). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Most card and online purchases in Europe go through Visa and Mastercard, two American companies that control much of the global payment system. European leaders believe this situation creates a risk because Europe depends on foreign companies for an important part of its economy. They now want to build a more independent system. One new solution is Wero, a digital wallet created by European banks and payment companies. It uses instant bank transfer to remove the middleman, reduce fees, and keep data inside Europe. Millions of people in Germany, France, and Belgium already use it. Leaders hope it will grow across the region. There are two main reasons for this plan: control and cost. The European Central Bank warns that strong reliance on a foreign system can lead to political pressure or a sudden problem. Retailers also say the card network fee rises each year. EU leaders say the payment system is key infrastructure, and infrastructure gives power. Difficult words: instant (happening immediately), middleman (a person or company between buyer and seller), reliance (when you depend on someone or something).

Most people in Europe use Visa or Mastercard for card payments . These are American companies, and EU leaders think this creates a problem because Europe depends on foreign systems for payments. They want a new European system. Wero is a digital wallet made by European banks. It uses direct bank transfer instead of a card network. This can lower fees and keep payment data in Europe. Many people in Germany, France, and Belgium already use it. Leaders say Europe needs more control over the payment system. They also want lower costs for shops and customers. They believe the payment system is important infrastructure and Europe should manage it. Difficult words: payment (giving money to buy something), foreign (from another country), direct (straight, without anyone in the middle). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Most people in Europe use Visa or Mastercard when they pay with a card. These companies come from the United States. EU leaders think that this is a problem. Europe uses a foreign system for payment . They want a European system. Wero is a new digital wallet from European banks. It uses a bank transfer. This can save money and keep data in Europe. Many people in Germany, France, and Belgium already use it. Leaders say that a payment system is very important. They want Europe to have more control and save money. They think that their own payment system makes Europe stronger. Difficult words: foreign (from another country), payment (when you give money to buy something), wallet (a small case for money and cards).

The European Commission has proposed new EU-wide prison sentences for firearms offences to reduce illegal gun trafficking and close legal loopholes between member states. Creating or sharing blueprints for 3D-printed guns could result in at least two years in prison. Possessing illegal firearms or key components could bring up to five years, while trafficking or manufacturing illegal weapons could lead to eight years behind bars. The Commission says around 620,000 firearms are lost or stolen in the EU, which contributes to organised crime, terrorism, and about 1,300 deaths each year. Officials warn that new technologies like 3D printing and weapons flowing from war zones increase the risk. The proposal also requires each country to create a National Firearms Focal Point, improve data collection on seized weapons, and share statistics regularly. The goal is stronger cooperation, better monitoring, and a more coordinated EU response to security threats. Difficult words: trafficking (illegal buying and selling of goods, often across borders), loophole (a weakness in a law that allows people to avoid punishment), possess (to have or own something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The European Commission wants the same prison rules for holding and using illegal guns in all EU countries. People who make, sell, or own illegal firearms could face two to eight years in prison. Sharing digital plans for 3D-printed guns would also be a crime. The problem is that different national laws help criminals move guns across borders. About 620,000 guns are lost or stolen in the EU, and gun violenc e kills around 1,300 people each year. New technology and wars outside Europe may increase illegal weapons in the region. The proposal also asks each country to create a special office and collect better information about illegal guns. Difficult words: firearm (a gun), national (related to a whole country), gun violence (harm or killing by guns). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The EU wants stricter rules for illegal guns. People who make, sell, or have illegal guns could go to prison for two to eight years. This also includes 3D-printed guns and sharing gun plans online. The EU says that many guns are lost. People also steal guns and use them in crime . Many people die in Europe each year. New technology and wars can bring more illegal guns to Europe. Each country should have a special office to work with other countries and share information about illegal guns. Difficult words: illegal (against the rules), include (to have something as part of a group), crime (doing something which is against the rules). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Asian stock markets fell sharply as investors reacted to fears that the Middle East war could cause an energy shock. Concerns about rising oil prices and higher inflation led many investors to sell shares, especially in technology and chipmaking companies. South Korea’s KOSPI index dropped more than 11%, while Japan and Taiwan also saw losses of over 4%. Analysts say markets now believe the conflict may last longer than expected, which increases uncertainty and risk. Investors worry that higher energy costs could delay interest rate cuts and weaken economic growth. Instead of panic selling, experts describe a gradual shift toward safer assets such as cash and gold. Some investors are reducing risk in their portfolios because the situation looks more unpredictable. Overall, markets are adjusting to the possibility of a long-term conflict that could have lasting economic effects, especially through energy prices and inflation pressure. Difficult words: concern (a feeling of worry about something), gradual (happening slowly, step by step), portfolio (a collection of investments). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Asian stock markets fell sharply because investors worry that the war in the Middle East could increase oil prices. Higher energy prices may cause inflation and affect interest rates. South Korea’s stock market dropped more than 11%, and Japan and Taiwan also had big losses. Investors are worried the conflict could last a long time. Many are selling risky shares , especially technology stocks, and moving money into cash and gold. Experts say this is not a crisis, but a careful change in investing. Markets are reacting to the risk of higher energy costs and economic problems if the war continues. Difficult words: stock market (a place where people buy and sell parts of companies), inflation (when prices of goods and services go up over time), share (a small part of a company which you can buy). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

They think that oil prices may go up. Higher oil prices can make many things more expensive . This can hurt the economy. South Korea’s stock market falls a lot. Japan and Taiwan stock markets fall too. Many investors are putting money into safer places like cash or gold. They are afraid that the war will last a long time. Energy prices may go up. Many people are worried about what will happen next. Difficult words: investor (a person who puts money into something to make more money), expensive (when something costs a lot of money), hurt (to cause problems). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Wine production depends on stable weather, but climate change is changing the conditions that growers need. In Chile, long droughts , higher temperatures, and unpredictable weather create serious problems for vineyards. Small producers struggle to survive as water becomes harder to find and heat damages grape plants. Large companies invest in science and new technology to protect crops and manage limited water resources more effectively. At the same time, warmer temperatures help cooler countries such as Germany produce better grapes. Wine quality has improved because grapes now ripen more easily. However, this advantage may not last. Rising soil temperatures, new pests , and extreme weather events could create future risks for these regions as well. Across the world, climate change is slowly changing the global wine map. Some regions gain new opportunities, while others face problems. Success increasingly depends on how quickly producers adapt their methods, protect natural resources, and respond to changing environmental conditions that affect the entire industry. Difficult words: drought (long time without rain), unpredictable (something that changes suddenly and you cannot know what will happen), ripen (when fruit becomes ready to eat), pest (a small animal or insect that damages plants). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Wine needs stable weather, but climate change is now changing many wine regions. In Chile, long droughts , heat, and unusual weather make grape growing difficult. Small farmers struggle because they don’t have enough water. Big companies use science and new tools to protect plants and control water use. In Germany, warmer weather helps grapes grow better than before. Wine quality improves because grapes ripen more easily. Still, new problems appear, such as bugs and stronger storms that can damage farms. Climate change changes where people can make wine. Some places can grow better wine, while others lose production. Wine producers must adapt quickly and change their methods if they want to stay successful in the future. Difficult words: stable (steady and not changing much), drought (long time without rain), ripen (when fruit becomes ready to eat). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Wine needs stable weather to grow well. Climate change now brings quick weather changes. In Chile, hot weather and little rain make grape farming hard. Farmers have less water. Some plants do not grow well. Big wine companies use new ideas to help their plants survive . In Germany, warmer weather helps grapes grow better. Farmers can make good wine more easily now. But new problems can come, like strong storms and harmful bugs. Climate change changes the world of wine. Some countries make more wine, and others make less. If farmers want to grow wine in the future, they must change how they work. Difficult words: stable (when something does not change much), survive (to stay alive or continue to exist), harmful (when something causes damage or problems). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Everything around us, including our bodies, is made from material that stars created billions of years ago. Ancient stars produced elements like carbon, oxygen, and iron, and when they exploded, these elements spread across the universe. Later, they came together to form planets, trees, and even humans. Stars form in cold molecular clouds, which are huge collections of gas and dust. Inside these clouds, gravity pulls material together into dense clumps . When these clumps collapse, they heat up and form protostars . As time passes, these stars begin nuclear fusion, turning hydrogen into helium. Stars spend most of their lives as main sequence stars, steadily burning their fuel. A star’s mass decides how fast it burns and how long it lives. Small stars can live for trillions of years, while massive stars live only a few million years. When a star’s fuel runs out, it either becomes a white dwarf or explodes in a powerful supernova, creating neutron stars or black holes. Through these processes, new stars and planets are born, continuing the cycle of life across the universe. Carl Sagan famously said that we are a way for the universe to know itself, showing how deeply connected we are to the cosmos and the stars that came before us. Difficult words: clump (a group of things that stick close together in one place), protostar (a small star), cosmos (the universe). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Stars are born inside very cold clouds of gas and dust called molecular clouds. These clouds are very big and heavy. Small parts inside the clouds come together and grow bigger. When they get heavy enough, they fall in on themselves and form baby stars called protostars. After some time, the inside gets hot, and a process called fusion starts. Fusion changes hydrogen into helium and gives the star energy. When a star uses all its hydrogen, it will become a white dwarf or a supernova. The star’s materials help to make new stars in the future. Old stars made the things in our bodies, like carbon and oxygen. These stars lived a long time before the Earth, the Sun, or our galaxy. When the stars exploded, they sent their elements across space. Later, these materials came together to make planets, stars, and people. Carl Sagan, a famous scientist, said that the universe is inside us and that we are made of star stuff. This means we are all connected to the stars in a very special way. Difficult words: white dwarf (a small hot star), explode (to break apart fast and loud), element (a basic building material of everything in the universe, for example, oxygen, carbon, iron). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Stars come from big, cold clouds of gas and dust . The clouds are very big and heavy. Small parts come together and make a baby star. This baby star is called a protostar. The star gets hot inside. It starts a special process called fusion. This makes the star shine and live for a long time. Small stars live longer than big stars. When a star uses all its fuel, it changes. Big stars explode . They send their material into space. This material makes planets and even people. Our bodies have things like carbon and oxygen. A famous scientist, Carl Sagan, says that we come from stars. The stars are part of us. We are all part of the universe. Difficult words: dust (very small pieces of rock and metal), fuel (something what gives energy), explode (to break apart fast and loudly). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
